body.$send: Sends an excerpt of the mail body to JEV, on top of subject and summary. The subject alone misleads (a rejection titled "News about your application"), but the mail content then leaves the machine. Off by default.

questions.text: Does the message explicitly ask the recipient for a reply or an action?
Does the message mention a deadline or a time-limited action?
Which main event does the message describe?

options.request: Request for information, a document or an action
options.administrative: Administrative update, proof, procedure or reminder
options.information: Useful information requiring no explicit action
options.other: None of the previous cases clearly fits

questions.text: What level of operational attention does this message require?
Does the message describe a concrete job offer or proposal?
Do the languages, frameworks and technologies mentioned overlap with the provided profile?
How well does the role match the provided profile and declared preferences?
